run_training: run the Keypoint-NeRF training pipeline with a config file and data root via the train.py CLI entry point
run_validation: run validation on a trained Keypoint-NeRF model checkpoint using the --run_val flag
create_parser: create an argparse parser for training arguments like data_root, out_dir, and num_gpus via config.create_parser
load_config: load a YAML config file for dataset, training, and model settings via config.load_cfg
get_model: instantiate a Keypoint-NeRF model from the loaded config dictionary via config.get_model
